title: KG-FairDiff: Knowledge Graph-Guided Prompt Refinement for Demographically Fair Text-to-Image Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating statistical divergence (Bias-P, Bias-W, KL divergence) of gender attributes estimated by FairFace from a uniform target distribution across occupation-based prompts.
Calculating statistical divergence (Bias-P, Bias-W, KL divergence) of racial attributes estimated by FairFace from a uniform target distribution across occupation-based prompts.
Calculating statistical divergence (Bias-P, Bias-W, KL divergence) of age attributes estimated by FairFace from a uniform target distribution across occupation-based prompts.
Retrieving non-Western cultural cues from a curated knowledge graph to refine prompts and qualitatively evaluating the inclusion of diverse cultural attire, concepts, and practices.
Measuring fairness metrics (Bias-P, Bias-W, ENS) for combined demographic categories, such as Race-Gender and Race-Gender-Age, to audit complex disparities.
